message: Carrying the archived flight's constraints and extraVerify entries over kept their from: "P2-01"/"P2-02" gates, which kukulu_plan_commit resolves against the new plan (where P2-02 is a different task); the planner had to notice and strip them by hand. A gate whose task is in an archived flight could be treated as satisfied, or kukulu_plan_commit could warn when a from id also appears in the newest archive.

Constraint no-hardcoded-mcp-timeout fails on docs/kukulu.json itself (its description and fixtures contain the literal it forbids), so kukulu_verify is ok:false on every task; it also blocks kukulu_task_done logs that mention the value.

kukulu_mutate reports every mutant as "killed: constraint no-hardcoded-mcp-timeout caught the mutation" because that constraint already fails on the unmutated tree (it scans docs/kukulu.json, which holds its own fixtures); the reviewer must read each command result by hand. A constraint that fails before the mutation should not count as a kill (compare against the baseline, as confirmKill does for commands).
